// RED fixture for `no-raw-publish` — the lint MUST reject this.
// A fire-and-forget direct broker publish that bypasses the outbox: the lost-event /
// causality-break bug class (F5). The event is NOT in the same transaction as the state
// change; if the process dies after the DB commit, the event is lost.
pub async fn handle(state: &mut State, broker: &Broker, e: Envelope) {
    state.apply(&e);
    broker.publish_now(&e).await;
}
